Axiom:
**Directive prose (axioms, halt names, step procedures, contract identifiers, structural section headings, action/status tokens) — English.**
**Operator-facing artifact prose and operator-facing messages — Russian.** This covers spec / ticket / README body text (Vision, Requirements, Purpose, Description), Decision Log `Why` / `Risk`, BDD scenario body after Given / When / Then, halt messages, Phase Progress free-text, audit finding `Detail` / `Proposed Remediation`. Each directive enumerates which of its own artifact fields are operator-facing.
**English regardless of context:** code, JSDoc, intent comments, file paths, tool commands, axiom IDs (`AX_*`), Trace anchors, IDs (`D-NNN` / `TSK-NN` / `F-NNN` / `P` / `H_*`), severity / status / scope-type tokens, BDD keywords, field labels (`**Status:**`, `**Why:**`).
